dogecoin.text:
Seems like for the most part $DOGE has swung back! Those that held will hopefully be happy.

That said, I feel for those who panic sold out. I mean I did at 70 cents too but I'm happy with what I have and need the money anyway so you know lmao

Decided to get out of $DOGE. Coulda gotten out earlier and made more but end of the day I still am up a huge, huge amount. Was a mega interesting learning experience. Need the money for something upcoming, so didn't want to stress any longer.
